summary_en: 7.54M shares (8.07% S/O), ¥39.96B limit, ToSTNeT-3 off-auction block execution 2026-09-01 08:45 JST at ¥5,300/share (prior close). Settlement same day.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via off-auction transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: NIFCO announced on 2026-08-31 the execution of a specific block acquisition of treasury shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-auction trading. The company will place a buy order on 2026-09-01 at 08:45 JST (Tokyo Stock Exchange opening time) for up to 7.54 million shares at ¥5,300/share (the prior day's close), with a maximum outlay of ¥39.96B. This block represents 8.07% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). Results will be published after market close the same day. This block acquisition is part of a broader buyback authorization approved on 2026-08-31 for up to 8.30 million shares (¥4.0B) over the period 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-18. Following completion of this ToSTNeT-3 block, the company intends to conduct further open-market purchases for any remaining authorized amount.
